title: Three generations gathered at the field with the third coming out in the fourth. Glove raised, sun high Glare of glory, let it Fly. #smallpoems
summary: Three generations gathered at the field with the third coming out in the fourth. Glove raised, sun high Glare of glory, let it Fly. #smallpoems
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Three generations gathered at the field
with the third coming out in the fourth.
Glove raised, sun high
Glare of glory, let it
Fly.
#smallpoems
